header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2019 and was lastly fixed in the court on 03.12.2019, and even on that date none was present on behalf of the petitioner. Even thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.

Perusal of the prayer clause reflects that the petitioner is seeking directions to concerned respondents not to interfere in the dispenser’s practice of petitioner or seal his shop/dispensary without any legal justification. In this regard, this court as well as the Hon’ble Supreme Court of Pakistan, has several times restrained the concerned authorities from disallowing such practices to the petitioners. Therefore, this petition being not maintainable, is hereby dismissed in limine.
